title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-20
lineage: SBD > MR > PCM > ZA2 > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with generally good sound despite occasional low‑quality sections, highlighted by a bang‑off opening Casey Jones and an electric set featuring a smoking Good Lovin'/Not Fade Away/Drums sandwich and scorching Viola Lee Blues.
ai_review.review: The show is widely praised for its energetic setlist – an explosive start with Casey Jones, a classic China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider transition, and a second electric half that many call "smoking" thanks to Good Lovin', Not Fade Away, drums, Viola Lee Blues and a heartfelt High Time.  The recording is mostly clear and captures the live atmosphere, though listeners note inconsistent levels on the early tracks and some low‑quality moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews range from 1 to 5 stars; most are positive about the performance while noting recording inconsistencies, yielding a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall clear and live‑feel soundboard capture, but early tracks suffer from low‑level/mic issues and occasional muffled sections; acoustic portion sounds better than the first electric tracks.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Good Lovin' / Not Fade Away / Drums
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening, smooth transition to an acoustic segment (with mic level changes), then a high‑energy electric second set that many reviewers describe as smoking.

band_member_comments.Drums: Praised for tight, driving performance in the Good Lovin'/Not Fade Away/Drums sequence.
